title: Concept: JNDI name lookup in application code (java)
description: In java, new InitialContext(payload) resolves a name at runtime. If the name can be influenced, the resolver — not the application — decides what gets loaded, which is remote code execution on older JDKs.
applicability: Java services that use JNDI for datasources, LDAP or messaging; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Remote class loading and code execution through a controlled naming provider; HIGH severity.
